A '''pressure lock''' was a [[Lock/Legends|locking]] mechanism used on [[Airlock/Legends|airlocks]]. The pressure lock prevented both the inner and outer airlock doors from being opened at the same time to prevent a loss of [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The airlocks on [[Research Station Shantipole]] were equipped with pressure locks.<ref name="SFS" />
